metadata.title: Investigation of the errors in SDSS proper-motion measurements using samples of quasars

notes: No eligible stars. The paper statistically analyzes quasar samples to characterize proper-motion errors and does not identify any individual star as a Galactic unbound candidate. The only individually mentioned stellar object is an unnamed white dwarf contaminant identified by plate=1642, mjd=53115, fiber=81 (T:p7-b1); it is not claimed to be unbound. The 30 mas/yr example at T:p15-b1 is hypothetical and has no stellar identifier.
